# Pre-market brief, Tue 2026-11-03 (~8:15 AM ET)

1. **Midterms today; Nasdaq-100 now in correction.** NQ closed Monday >10% below its record high. Futures at ~6:17 ET: Dow -0.7%, S&P -0.1%, NQ +0.3% ([Reuters/Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/us-stock-futures-mixed-as-apple-slides-midterms-loom-4994306); [StreetInsider](https://www.streetinsider.com/General+News/Premarket+movers%3A+Apple%2C+Palantir%2C+Dynatrace+slide+premarket%3B+Grab%2C+Upwork+jump/27277369.html)). A surprise GOP sweep would likely lift yields and the dollar ([Reuters](https://live.euronext.com/en/financial-news/stocks-slip-ai-angst-and-us-midterms-keep-investors-wary)).
2. **AAPL -4 to -4.5% pre:** record Q4 revenue but warned memory costs will squeeze holiday-quarter gross margin; iPad missed ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/03/stocks-making-the-biggest-moves-premarket-pfe-pltr-aapl-zbra.html)). **PLTR -6 to -8%:** beat and raised FY to $8.53B, but total contract value grew only 6% y/y vs 49% in Q2 (same sources). Both go in avoid.
3. **Oil whipsaw:** Brent +1.6% to ~$106.5 after a limited US strike on Iran's Qeshm Island, a day after -8% ([AP](https://apnews.com/article/stock-markets-ai-earnings-oil-0d235af127a92c68da0cc2c45c028cef)). Energy stays in avoid until it settles.
4. **Rates/BTC:** 10-yr +4 bp to 4.937%, 2-yr 4.60% ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/03/us-treasury-yields-bonds.html)); BTC ~$77.0k, flat ([Reuters](https://live.euronext.com/en/financial-news/stocks-slip-ai-angst-and-us-midterms-keep-investors-wary)).
5. **Other movers:** DT -16%, RVTY +7% (guide raised), GRAB +8.4% (EBITDA guide raised), DD +1.2% (FY EPS guide raised to $7.47–7.52), PFE flat on beat, YUM +1% on beat ([StreetInsider](https://www.streetinsider.com/General+News/Premarket+movers%3A+Apple%2C+Palantir%2C+Dynatrace+slide+premarket%3B+Grab%2C+Upwork+jump/27277369.html); [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/03/stocks-making-the-biggest-moves-premarket-pfe-pltr-aapl-zbra.html)).
6. **Data:** JOLTS 10:00 today; ADP and ISM Services Wed; claims Thu; October jobs Fri.
7. **Earnings ([TiltRadar](https://tiltradar.com/earnings-this-week)):** today AMC AMD, ANET, SMCI, XYZ, DUOL; Wed UBER, DDOG, NVO before the open, QCOM, ARM, APP after; Thu ABNB, NET, AFRM after; Fri MRNA before the open; next Mon TTD, HIMS; Nov 12 AMAT, CSCO.

## Swing ideas
- **DD** long, low. FY EPS guide raised to $7.47–7.52 from $7.17–7.32, Q4 above estimates; a non-tech beat-and-raise, our best-working setup two weeks running. Risk: small +1.2% gap in a weak, election-driven tape.
- Skipped RVTY and GRAB because gaps over 5% tend to fade from the open (see lessons).
